name: 911 Batch Repeater
description: Finds repeat parts for a 911 QTDR batch. Reads DYPN numbers from each nest's 911 Batch Excel, then opens a nest-selection window where you pick which nests to run and toggle exactly what the repeater grabs per nest (NC files, inspection PDFs, batch/nest restamp, overwrite). Matches against the Master Parts Library (.NC) and Master Inspection Library (PDFs) and copies into per-nest repeats folders.
author: Anthony Sieben

fields.label: 911 QTDR Root
